معدات:Turbine Thrust Bearing
رقم الوثيقة: Turb-011-r0

صدرت إلى:
 Aswan Dam 2 PS

حالة: 
 موافقة
إجراء:Equipment Inspections (I3-Y1)
موافقة تاريخ: 22 May 2005

تاريخ ليكون 
 تمت المراجعة: May 2010
مقدمة

This document outline the equipment 
inspection checklist I3, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

Turbine bearing is the bearing which carry the weight of all running parts of 
the unit and carry the vertical water force component.

Thrust bearing located up to the main bearing and 
it is carried by the turbine cover.

This document shows the protective maintenance which 
must be performed to discover any oil leakage and check that all parts are 
تشديد ويكونون في أماكنهم.

This document is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abd El Kader Mahmoud, 
accepted by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, approved by 
eng. approved by eng. Mohamed Abd El Baset 
Head Sector of Aswan Dam 1&2 PS and certified by by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC 
inspection and quality control general director & MPIS Coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
The unit must be stopped and the break on
The oil circulating pumps must be off
Gate lock and break must be on

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
Safety and healthy equipment.
Wrenches.
العمل المراد تنفيذه

Monitor oil condition when 
a change of oil is necessary.

Clean the entire 
system properly.

Filter the new oil to 70 
microns or better before it is put into the oil system.

Check the thermo signal 
bulb if it is in its place or not.

Check the tightening of 
all visual parts into the bearing.
Change the coupling rubber.

Clean the strainer of the 
oil.

Clean the heat exchanger 
by reversing the pass of the water circulation.
